title: Beat the Bluff
description:
An audio-first casual puzzle-strategy game set in The Listening Club, a cozy town bar. Listen to short audio sequences, remember what you heard, detect what changed and spot patterns. In Bluff Rounds one player answers a question about the sequence and the other must decide: trust them or challenge them?

Play a solo campaign against Club members, a once-a-day Daily Challenge, or online 1v1 matches, public or private. Equip abilities such as Replay, Extra Time, Shield and Double Down before a match, and climb the daily and all-time leaderboards. Designed to be fully playable by blind and visually impaired players.
